# History Rewrite Map — vendor-name scrub (2026-09-05)

The `main` branch history was rewritten with `git filter-repo` to remove
the originating vendor's product name from 11 upstream-fork commit
messages and from historical blob content (local checkout path strings).
Policy: no runtime path carries a preset vendor endpoint; the same rule
now applies to the recorded history.

- Rewrite tool: `git filter-repo --replace-message --replace-text`
- Rules: the vendor product name (all case forms) → the neutral project
  word; the local checkout path prefix → the neutral repo path; the
  machine fingerprint → a REDACTED token. (The literal replaced strings
  are deliberately not reproduced in this file — see the filter-repo
  rule files in the operator transcript for exact patterns.)
- Scope: all commits reachable from `main` (13,240 parsed).
  `master` (tip `b150a551b8`) contained no matching commits or blobs —
  its SHAs are unchanged and it was not re-pushed.
  `digital-assets` is an orphan branch (clean, single commit `6ef395f`)
  — not part of this rewrite, unaffected.
